rating.comments: The first student message and its repeat are the pasted task statement, so they were ignored. "jhlk" and "jhjh" are off-task noise. "if they do not understand they can ask a AI" gives a brief reason for a positive impact, and "parfois on devient acro est on peut plus arrêté de regarder" describes a negative impact with a reason (addiction, inability to stop). Both points echo ideas the AI had raised rather than extending them, and the student asked no questions. Two complete, task-focused attempts earn effort 3, with little follow-through.
